topics.quote: ms. digiacomo motioned to approve the minutes of the july 2, 2019 meeting.
ms. doherty presented her end of year report to the board, and is on the board of selectmen agenda for august 13, 2019.
ms. lincoln opined the orientation packets are "horribly out of date."

topics.resolution: ceremony to be scheduled for November
topics.quote: a ceremony is to be scheduled for some time in november.
ms. doherty said she's received communication from the town manager that the personnel committee is looking favorably toward advancing the step for the director position.
ms. lincoln reported the shuffleboard court is complete, and it will be showcased at the volunteer appreciation cookout.
ms. doherty reported the dpw has found a painter to take care of the ramp coming down to the eagle house
ms. doherty talked about upcoming events at the senior center
ms. lincoln reported that she attended the supporters meeting on july 12, 2019.
ms. digiacomo motioned to adjourn the meeting, mr. lincoln seconded. on vote, motion carried unanimously.
